items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1976-02-19
items.q: Remarkable musician, of course, but not relevant to a discussion in jazz.

ctx.x: Remarkable musician, of course, but not relevant to a discussion in jazz. Yeah. And it's unfortunate that his work has had to be estimated, uh, in a jazz context, since, uh, since, unfortunately, it's just not part of it. Now, uh, we also have a number of celebrated musicians who are excellent musicians who happen not to be able to play jazz, although they are credited with it. And so, uh, it becomes necessary to understand, that all of those musicians who are not playing in this form are not merely out on a limb…
in other words, jazz, uh, the way you define it is New Orleans jazz.
